summary: A 61-year-old male suffered a serious head injury when a large slab dislodged under his feet near Snowmass Lake ~3:30 PM; Garmin inReach SOS. MRA carried him out; CareFlight and a HAATS helicopter responded; flown to St. Mary's Medical Center in Grand Junction.
location: Near Snowmass Lake, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight; Colorado Army National Guard (HAATS)
notes: MRA FB mission post (posted 2023-07-27). Org-post source per user rule 2026-09-17; permalink opened live by browser task.
